Parse a JavaScript class declaration.

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"javascript\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "class Foo { bar() {} }", config: configObj)
print(result)
```
